crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the…
He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your…
He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft.…
The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is…
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth…
You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach…
He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay…
Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.
But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you…
for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

translations.web: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand, and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
translations.kjv: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
translations.asv: Then Jehovah put forth his hand, and touched my mouth; and Jehovah said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth:
